calibration.lower_stability_bound: standard-normal CDF of conditional latent mean divided by conditional latent standard deviation minus the calibrated object-level standardized shortfall multiplier
calibration.object_score: maximum of max(0, (conditional latent mean - observed latent shake stability) / conditional latent standard deviation) over every valid-anchor family, registered selector, budget, and structurally available non-reference pose
calibration.tie_rule: use the conservative higher order statistic

decision_and_aggregation.certificate_coverage: an object is covered only when every family, selector, budget, and available action is simultaneously covered
decision_and_aggregation.certified_action: lexicographically first structurally available non-reference pose with lower stability bound at least 0.5
decision_and_aggregation.false_safe_rate: unstable certified selections divided by all non-abstaining selections; zero when there are no non-abstaining selections

fixed_order_control.rule: for each integer index 0 through 255, sort poses 2 through 16 by SHA-256(domain_separator || NUL || decimal_index || NUL || decimal_pose), with pose identifier as the digest-tie break; the 256 resulting full orders must be unique
fixed_order_control.summary: exact arithmetic mean over the frozen 256 orders at each budget

decision_and_aggregation.object_regret_auc: mean family regret AUC within each object before any cross-object inference
decision_and_aggregation.oracle: lexicographically first structurally available non-reference pose with a Pass shake label, or abstain if none passes
decision_and_aggregation.selected_probe_diversity: number of distinct pose identifiers selected by the decision-directed policy anywhere in the evaluated cohort
decision_and_aggregation.unsafe_action_rate: unstable certified selections divided by all family-budget decisions, including abstentions

latent_response_twin.action_block_layout: eight projected pre-shake feature coordinates followed by one latent shake-stability coordinate, action-major for poses 1 through 16

covariance.estimator: sample covariance with ddof=1 over complete fit families
covariance.jitter: max(1e-8 times the median positive shrunk variance, float64 epsilon)
covariance.mean: arithmetic mean over complete fit families

latent_response_twin.fit_family_requirement: every fit family must contain all 16 structurally available pose records; otherwise the archive gate fails before any outcome payload is opened
latent_response_twin.posterior_stability_probability: standard-normal CDF of conditional latent mean divided by conditional latent standard deviation, with the registered deterministic zero-variance limit

dimension_reduction.fit_records: every structurally present pre-shake pose record from the ten fit objects
dimension_reduction.method: thin-SVD principal components of fit-standardized records without using any phase or shake label
dimension_reduction.sign_rule: make the largest-absolute loading in each component positive, breaking equal-absolute-loading ties by the lowest raw coordinate index

fit_only_standardization.center: coordinate-wise arithmetic mean over every structurally present pre-shake pose record from the ten fit objects
fit_only_standardization.constant_coordinate_rule: replace a zero population standard deviation with one
fit_only_standardization.scale: coordinate-wise population standard deviation with ddof=0

preprocessing.raw_pose_record: the exact fixed-dimensional pre-shake tensor admitted by the parent mapping constraints and the future structure-only archive mapping lock
